entities.summary: Ottoman, a notable figure in the history of Armenia, associated with Ottoman-Safavid Partitioned Armenia (1514–1722). Preceded by Ottoman Western Armenia and Ottoman Empire. Their legacy influenced Shah Abbas I forcibly deports Armenians to New Julfa, Isfahan.
